title: DRisk platform terminology
summary: A glossary placeholder for the terms customers need when working with DRisk.

blocks.text: This article will define the key terms used in the DRisk interface and documentation. The definitions below are placeholders and must be checked against the approved product vocabulary.

items: Framework: the confirmed term for a structured set of compliance requirements.
Requirement: the confirmed term for an expectation that an organisation may need to address.
Control: the confirmed term for an action, measure, or practice used to address a requirement.
Evidence: the confirmed term for information that supports a control or assessment.
Readiness: the confirmed term for the organisation's view of its current compliance position.

blocks.text: Using consistent terms helps teams discuss compliance work clearly and makes it easier to connect requirements, controls, evidence, and readiness reviews.
